input_ref: explore | Member: Is the price I see a guarantee?

output.reason: No unit fully answers this. U-BEN-COST-001-02 does say an estimate is not a guarantee, but it only covers a cost the advocate quotes for a covered in-network medical visit. The member is asking about a price they see themselves, which fits the pharmacy web page in the FAQ units. U-WEB-FAQ-04 explains why a pharmacy charge can differ, and U-WEB-FAQ-05 explains how to get the current estimate. Neither says whether the displayed price is guaranteed.
